reference.implementation: Java Android View/EditText/Dialog/Canvas/SharedPreferences; no WebView or network permission

method: Guarded ADB PNG first; fresh UIA second; non-atomic independent D observation. Every PNG opened with view_image; XML and metadata read independently. Not REA Evidence and not original-product A.

taskAcceptance.scope: Runnable independent native components and representative chat/settings/dialog pages; local fixture backend only.

acceptance.result: Java View/EditText/Dialog/Canvas/SharedPreferences actual installed APK; no WebView or network permission.
Contracts and A/B to D mapping retained; independent cancellation, persistence and recovery explicitly D.
D01–D09 and D17–D20 verified by actual device paths and pixels/XML.

acceptance.requirement: D strategies, launch commands and platform limits
acceptance.result: Reference README, contracts, comparison and status document distinguish this APK from original Kimi.

taskAcceptance.scope: Representative paired comparison completed with explicit remaining D differences; not a claim of pixel identity, full original-function reconstruction, original fonts, real model/subscription services, or untested platforms.

acceptance.result: Exact-content capacity and same-value Appearance primary pairs; same-content completion plus dialog/keyboard component comparisons additionally reviewed.
Specific measured semantic bounds and visual/behavior differences are recorded, with unknown source font/fallback and non-atomic limits.
Source times/origins, systemLocales null versus en-US, account/service differences, alternate draft/dialog background contents and native font choice disclosed.
Extra top system inset, clipped content shadows, IME-obscured composer and wrapped Save label fixed as D; final-build paired and keyboard/settings/chat paths recaptured.

taskAcceptance.scope: Minimal single-note local Fieldnotes transfer; no original chat business/model service or sync claim.

acceptance.result: Fieldnotes library/editor manage a local note title; Kimi brand/model/mascot absent from notes pages.
Rounded grouped surfaces, contextual Edit/Delete, current-value settings, safe draft copy, Cancel/Retry and confirmation structure reused; notes business/state policies D.
D10–D17 cover actual save, explicit retry, actual cancellation/late callback, navigation, draft/saved process retention and destructive cancel/confirm.

checks.title: Empty native chat
checks.result: Visible empty guidance and native composer; final restoration empty.

checks.title: Actual local Send
checks.result: Real Send operation completed with OK after explicit 7-second wait; local fixture only.

checks.title: Actual Stop and late callback
checks.result: Fresh Stop output tapped while actual Retry pending; waited 7 seconds; Output stopped persisted.

checks.title: Held busy and Stop
checks.result: Held fixture independently displays generation and Stop affordance; stopping changes result.

checks.title: Chat error and Retry
checks.result: Retained failed prompt and explicit Retry; actual retry completes OK after 7-second wait.

checks.title: Draft navigation and process
checks.result: Native field above IME; first Back hides IME; Appearance return and stop/launch without scene preserve exact draft.

checks.title: Font preview cancel and Save
checks.result: Back abandons Extra Large preview; reentry has Follow System check; Save returns home; reentry summary Extra Large.

checks.title: Immediate theme and restore
checks.result: Dark palette and summary visible immediately; theme and font restored to Follow System.

checks.title: Destructive confirmation
checks.result: Cancel, Back and outside close preserve chat; Delete clears own fixture.

checks.title: Notes empty and validation
checks.result: Blank title shows native error icon; focus reveals Enter a note title popup; Back returns library.

checks.title: Notes draft navigation/process
checks.result: Return/New and stop/launch without scene preserve exact Run03 transfer draft.

checks.title: Actual note Save and saved process retention
checks.result: Actual Save after 7-second wait creates saved card; stop/launch without scene preserves saved title.

checks.title: Held note busy/cancel
checks.result: Saving and Cancel saving visible; Cancel retains draft and prior Research reading list card.

checks.title: Actual note cancellation and late callback
checks.result: Actual Save canceled via fresh label; after 7 seconds draft remains, prior saved title unchanged, New restores canceled draft.

checks.title: Note failure and Retry
checks.result: Error explains draft retention; actual retry commits retained title after 7-second wait.

checks.title: Notes deletion
checks.result: Cancel retains note; confirmed Delete returns to empty guidance.

checks.title: Interrupted process policy
checks.result: Actual pending chat reloads stopped; pending note save reloads error with retained draft and explicit retry succeeds; D policies.

checks.title: Capacity pair and fixture behavior
checks.result: Exact observed source content retained; Upgrade explains local fixture; Retry repeats local capacity failure.

checks.title: Model and effort native sheets
checks.result: Model selection preserves draft; Low/High are labeled independent options; Low summary survives sheet reentry.

checks.title: Restore and stop
checks.result: Restored theme/font Follow System, English, Instant High and empty content; last device action force-stops only reference package.

realCancellationTiming.limits: Host action interval is not a measured Android animation or exact callback timestamp. The app schedules a D 6000ms callback; cancellation was freshly observed and the later output/state was reviewed.
Host action interval is not a measured Android animation or exact callback timestamp. The app schedules a D 6000ms callback; cancellation was freshly observed and the later output/state was reviewed.

lastDeviceAction.description: Stop only the independent reference package; preserve local reference data

restoration.outcome: Reference defaults restored and reference package stopped. Device ownership explicitly returned to root; reviewer performs no further ADB. Original package/other emulator not operated in this D acceptance.
restoration.avdShutdown: Owned by root after handback; not performed by reviewer

limits: Reference self-test does not prove original source fidelity; see separate A↔D comparison.
Only final-build scenes 019–071 establish final APK runtime acceptance. Earlier scenes are repair evidence, irrespective of their names containing final.
Original screenshots are unmodified. No external delivery, account action, original-app launch, other-emulator control, or AVD shutdown was performed by this reviewer.
No TalkBack/RTL/physical-device, original font fallback, exact animation timing/easing, real network/model/subscription/voice/file service equivalence claimed.
Native full rerender resets focus/selection on state changes; note Save completes with cleared editor until Return, with no separate success banner.
During note saving the editor remains editable and completion consumes current draft; that independent D policy is not attributed to Kimi.
